claims.subject: central controller
claims.quote: The central controller is implemented as a StateGraph-style sequential function chart.

claims.subject: sensors connector
claims.quote: A single sensors connector bundles measured process values

claims.subject: actuators connector
claims.value: automated valve, pump and thermal commands
claims.quote: A single actuators connector bundles automated valve, pump and thermal commands

claims.subject: Manual/isolation valves
claims.quote: Manual/isolation valves shown on the P&ID are intentionally excluded from the normal StateGraph actuator bundle unless specifically stated in the ICD.

claims.subject: Branch A
claims.quote: Branch A cools the condensate in B6 and then returns it.

claims.subject: join
claims.quote: A join is satisfied only when both branches report completion.

claims.subject: B5 heater permissive
claims.quote: B5 heater permissive: LIS-501 >= 0.05 m AND FIS-801 >= 0.10 kg/s.

claims.subject: P1 permissive
claims.quote: P1 permissive: LIS-701 > 0.02 m.

claims.subject: Low discharge pressure alarm for P1
claims.quote: Low discharge pressure alarm if PIS-901 < 0.8 bar(g) while running.

claims.subject: P2 permissive
claims.quote: P2 permissive: LIS-601 > 0.02 m.

claims.subject: Low discharge pressure alarm for P2
claims.quote: Low discharge pressure alarm if PIS-1001 < 0.8 bar(g) while running.

claims.subject: Automated valves
claims.quote: Automated valves fail closed and are not treated as modulating valves.

claims.subject: Controller valve-group assignments
claims.quote: Controller valve-group assignments shall follow CR-017.

claims.subject: condensate from B6
claims.quote: recovered condensate from B6 returns to B1

claims.subject: concentrate from B7
claims.quote: cooled concentrate from B7 returns to B2

claims.subject: controller.sensors.LIS_301
claims.quote: controller.sensors.LIS_301 = B3.level;

claims.subject: controller.sensors.QIS_502
claims.quote: controller.sensors.QIS_502 = B5.medium.Xi[NaCl];

claims.subject: V9.open
claims.quote: V9.open = controller.actuators.T5_Heater;

claims.subject: HeatB5.Q_flow
claims.quote: HeatB5.Q_flow = if controller.actuators.T5_Heater then 20000 else 0;
